# agent-mac-awake

> agent-mac-awake keeps a Mac awake during long Cursor and Grok Bot runs. It is a thin wrapper around macOS caffeinate, with an optional LaunchAgent, for people who leave an agent running on a Mac. MIT License.

macOS keep-awake CLI for people running long Cursor or Grok Bot sessions on a Mac. SPDX: MIT. Copyright (c) 2026 LofiSu. Contact: https://github.com/loomlab-ai, https://github.com/LofiSu, lofisuchat@gmail.com, GitHub Sponsors, https://x.com/su_lofi.
